novoe.pipetka_text: The color picker (J) shows the color under the cursor and copies its code. In the selection window the arrow keys move the frame by 1 point, Shift by 10, Alt+arrows change its size.
ozn.pipetka_text: A color from the screen and a precise frame
pipetka.picked_sub: You can draw marks with this color
pipetka.tip:
Color picker (J)
Point at a spot: magnified pixels and the color are shown. A click copies the color code, Esc: leave
